reference.quote: only 8% of controls had Lp(a) levels ≥100 nmol/L and 4% Lp(a) levels ≥150 nmol/L
reference.source: CKB 对照组 Lp(a) 分布（PMID 40297899）：≥100 nmol/L 占 8%、≥150 nmol/L 占 4%，据此拟合对数正态（中位数约 19.2 nmol/L）；按 Copenhagen 研究原文 50 mg/dL≈105 nmol/L 换算为质量单位（中位数约 92 mg/L）。检测方法与 apo(a) 异构体会使换算存在误差

chd.per_unit: mg/L（原文为每降低 100 nmol/L，按 105 nmol/L≈50 mg/dL 折算约 476 mg/L；原文结局为心肌梗死）

evidence.quote: there were concordant RRs per 100 nmol/L lower Lp(a) in East Asian individuals and European individuals for risk of MI (0.78 [95% CI, 0.72–0.84] versus 0.78 [0.76–0.81], respectively)

population.cohort: 东亚两样本孟德尔随机化（CKB、BioBank Japan 等）

overlap.rationale_zh: Lp(a) 主要由遗传决定，与 LDL-C 的机制重叠有限，但常规 LDL-C 测定包含 Lp(a) 胆固醇；摘要未说明全因死亡模型是否校正 LDL-C，按仅校正年龄性别处理取上限 0.3。冠心病结局为孟德尔随机化估计，单列系数 0.8

population.cohort: Copenhagen City Heart Study + Copenhagen General Population Study

measurement.source: 免疫比浊法受 apo(a) 异构体影响，方法间差异较大（一般实验室质量数据，未经文献核对）

interventions.note_zh: Lp(a) 水平主要由遗传决定，生活方式影响很小；目前尚无获批的特异性降 Lp(a) 药物，升高者宜更严格控制其他危险因素

test.label_zh: 抽血查脂蛋白(a)（一生至少一次）

evidence.quote: For cardiovascular mortality, a 50 mg/dL (105 nmol/L) increase in lipoprotein(a) levels was associated observationally with a hazard ratio of 1.16 (1.09-1.23), and genetically with risk ratios of 1.23 (1.08-1.41) based on LPA KIV2 and of 0.98 (0.88-1.09) based on LPA rs10455872. For all-cause mortality, corresponding values were 1.05 (1.01-1.09), 1.10 (1.04-1.18), and 0.97 (0.92-1.02), respectively.
